_README: DATABASE CONNECTION STRING - edit DefaultConnection below.
Committed on purpose so a new developer can clone and run without hunting for it.
Safe to commit because it uses Windows authentication - there is no password in it.
NEVER replace it with 'User Id=...;Password=...' - that credential would live in git history forever.
Server values: local default '.', named instance '.\SQLEXPRESS', LocalDB '(localdb)\MSSQLLocalDB', remote 'MACHINENAME'.
Need SQL authentication? Keep the password out of this file and set a user-secret, which overrides this value:
Deployment can also override with the ATTENDANCE_ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection environment variable.
